id: \bI'm channeling my energy. Don't bother me.
en: \bI'm channeling my energy. Don't bother me.
it: \bSto concentrando le mie energie. Non disturbarmi.

id: \bYou messed up my flow.
en: \bYou messed up my flow.
it: \bMi hai rovinato il ritmo.

id: \rSlowpoke
en: \rSlowpoke
it: \rSlowpoke

id: \bDiantha is so strong.
en: \bDiantha is so strong.
it: \bDiantha è fortissima.

id: \bYou challenged her too? Wasn't it hard?
en: \bYou challenged her too? Wasn't it hard?
it: \bHai sfidato anche tu lei? Non è stata dura?

id: \rDiantha: Is that a Mega Ring? You must be a powerful Mega Evolution Trainer.
en: \rDiantha: Is that a Mega Ring? You must be a powerful Mega Evolution Trainer.
it: \rDiantha: Quello è un Megacerchio? Devi essere un Allenatore esperto di Megaevoluzione.

id: \rYou don't know what Mega Evolution is? That's alright, I can teach you.
en: \rYou don't know what Mega Evolution is? That's alright, I can teach you.
it: \rNon sai cos'è la Megaevoluzione? Non importa, posso insegnartelo io.

id: \rMega Evolution is the power to enhance a Pokémon beyond regular evolution. Let me show you.
en: \rMega Evolution is the power to enhance a Pokémon beyond regular evolution. Let me show you.
it: \rLa Megaevoluzione è il potere di potenziare un Pokémon oltre la normale evoluzione. Lascia che te lo mostri.

id: \rImpressive, isn't it? You'll be able to learn more if you head north. Gurkinn should be able to tell you.
en: \rImpressive, isn't it? You'll be able to learn more if you head north. Gurkinn should be able to tell you.
it: \rImpressionante, vero? Potrai saperne di più se vai a nord. Gurkinn dovrebbe riuscire a spiegartelo.

id: \rTake this with you as well. Can't Mega Evolve without a stone.
en: \rTake this with you as well. Can't Mega Evolve without a stone.
it: \rPorta con te anche questa. Non si può megaevolvere senza una pietra.

id: \bDon't come near me.
en: \bDon't come near me.
it: \bNon avvicinarti.

id: \bHaven't I seen you before? You tried to take my Pancham.
en: \bHaven't I seen you before? You tried to take my Pancham.
it: \bNon ti ho già visto? Hai cercato di prendere il mio Pancham.

id: \rHelp me raise my team.
en: \rHelp me raise my team.
it: \rAiutami a crescere la mia squadra.

id: \rMy babies are doing so well.
en: \rMy babies are doing so well.
it: \rI miei piccoli se la cavano così bene.

id: \rKorrina: Finally! I've been waiting for you. You're my last Trainer before I finish my 100 challenger fight.
en: \rKorrina: Finally! I've been waiting for you. You're my last Trainer before I finish my 100 challenger fight.
it: \rOrnella: Finalmente! Ti stavo aspettando. Sei l'ultimo Allenatore prima di completare la mia sfida da 100 lotte.

id: \rOnce I'm done I can go search for a Mega Stone for Lucario.
en: \rOnce I'm done I can go search for a Mega Stone for Lucario.
it: \rQuando avrò finito potrò andare a cercare una Megapietra per Lucario.

id: \rThanks for the help. I'm gonna go look for my stone now.
en: \rThanks for the help. I'm gonna go look for my stone now.
it: \rGrazie dell'aiuto. Ora vado a cercare la mia pietra.

id: \rWait, you're doing gyms here? I'm looking forward to you then. Later.
en: \rWait, you're doing gyms here? I'm looking forward to you then. Later.
it: \rAspetta, stai affrontando le Palestre di qui? Allora non vedo l'ora di sfidarti. A presto.

id: \bWe just found a flower for her.
en: \bWe just found a flower for her.
it: \bAbbiamo appena trovato un fiore per lei.

id: \bMy wife loves spending time with Flabébé.
en: \bMy wife loves spending time with Flabébé.
it: \bA mia moglie piace tanto passare il tempo con Flabébé.

id: \rYou're about to see perfection.
en: \rYou're about to see perfection.
it: \rStai per vedere la perfezione.

id: \rYou're not half bad.
en: \rYou're not half bad.
it: \rNon sei niente male.
